marketing.title: Grade10 — graded cards, bought and sold in one place
marketing.description: Buy graded slabs outright from the Grade10 store, or bid on the ones that only come up once. One account carries your profile, your orders, and your bids.

store.title: Store — Grade10
store.description: Graded slabs at a fixed price, each listed with its grade. Browse the Grade10 store and check out when you are ready.

auction.title: Auctions — Grade10
auction.description: Every published Grade10 sale and the lots under it, with the top bid on each. Browsing needs no account; bidding does.
